# one-by.one

> An iPhone app for people who plan with AI assistants: an ordered day plan, one doable action at a time, and results recorded with units. Coming soon to iPhone. For ages 16+.

## Launch scope and language
Last updated: October 5, 2026. Worldwide launch except the entire EU/EEA (the 27 EU member states: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain and Sweden; plus Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway), the United Kingdom, Switzerland, mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao (Macau), Russia, Belarus, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Türkiye (Turkey) and Vietnam. These exclusions reflect representative requirements in the EU/EEA, United Kingdom and Switzerland, and ChatGPT/Claude availability, sanctions, registration or localization requirements in the other excluded markets. The interface is English-only; App Store availability and prices are country-specific. See https://one-by.one/terms/#launch-scope.

## How it works
Tell ChatGPT, Claude or an MCP-capable personal assistant what you want to do. With your approval, the AI reads planning context and saves a queue of action cards through MCP. Your iPhone shows one card at a time with Start, Done, Not today and Undo for mistaken taps. AI changes require your explicit request and approved permissions.

Custom MCP connector: https://mcp.one-by.one/mcp. Setup: https://one-by.one/connect/. Any agent with remote HTTP, OAuth discovery and dynamic client registration can connect, including local loopback callbacks. Up to three AI connections per account; unverified clients are labelled Unverified app on approval. OAuth sign-in and separate product permissions: context:read, activity:read, activity:write. Connector availability depends on the AI service; a directory listing is not assumed to be available.

## Connect an AI agent (read this to connect)
Full machine-readable instructions with per-tool commands: https://one-by.one/connect/index.md (human page: https://one-by.one/connect/).
- Server: https://mcp.one-by.one/mcp
- Transport: remote streamable HTTP. OAuth sign-in with dynamic client registration; no API key or token.
- Permissions: context:read, activity:read, activity:write. Limit: 3 AI connections per account. Unverified clients show "Unverified app" on approval.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http onebyone https://mcp.one-by.one/mcp`, then `/mcp` in a session.
- Codex CLI: `codex mcp add onebyone --url https://mcp.one-by.one/mcp`, then `codex mcp login onebyone`.
- Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, ChatGPT and Claude web/Desktop use a config entry or UI steps; see the index.md file above.
Instruction a user can paste into an agent:
```text
Add the one-by.one MCP server to yourself and connect it.

- Server URL: https://mcp.one-by.one/mcp
- Transport: remote streamable HTTP. Name the server "onebyone".
- Auth: OAuth sign-in with dynamic client registration. There is no API key or token, so do not ask me for one.

Steps:
1. Add the server to your MCP configuration and keep my existing servers. If you cannot change your own configuration, give me the exact command or setting for this client.
2. Start the OAuth sign-in. If you cannot open a browser, show me the sign-in link.
3. I will sign in to my one-by.one account and approve the permissions: context:read, activity:read and activity:write. The approval screen may label you "Unverified app"; that is normal for unverified clients.
4. When I am back, confirm that the onebyone tools are listed. Do not create or change any plans until I ask. If the connection is refused because the limit of 3 AI connections is reached, tell me.

Instructions for each client: https://one-by.one/connect/index.md
```

## Pricing
Launch pricing in the United States: US$12.99/month or US$59.99/year. A 14-day introductory free trial is available to eligible new subscribers, as determined by the App Store. No free tier. The App Store shows local pricing, eligibility and renewal terms. Existing data stays readable when a subscription lapses; paid features and AI connections need a subscription. Cancel renewal through Apple at least 24 hours before the trial or period ends.

## Privacy
No sale of data, advertising use or cross-app tracking. Optional calendar sharing is off until you choose calendars; the connected AI can receive the next seven days of selected event titles and times. Share times only substitutes “Busy” for event names. Connected AI clients receive saved content requested by tools under the permissions you approve; their own policies and settings apply. See the privacy policy for encryption, operator access, retention, deletion and sharing limits.

Publisher: salad76, a sole proprietorship in the Republic of Korea represented by Seungeun Kim, doing business as one-by.one. Legal address: 302, 173 Donggwang-ro, Seocho-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea. Privacy officer, DPO and Quebec privacy responsible person: Seungeun Kim (privacy@one-by.one). Contact: support@one-by.one; privacy@one-by.one.

Governing law is the Republic of Korea; disputes are subject to the Seoul Central District Court except where mandatory law provides otherwise. Mandatory consumer protections in the user's country or state of residence and the right to bring a claim in the courts of the user's country under those protections are preserved. Support and privacy email is routed by Cloudflare Email Routing to Google (Gmail), with processing in the United States and other provider data-center countries. Transfer safeguards are each provider's data processing agreement and standard contractual safeguards; no particular certification is claimed.
